title: God Loves Me
bigIdea: God loves you so much that He gave His Son, Jesus.

memoryVerse.text: How you made me is amazing and wonderful.

moral.lesson: God loves you more than you can imagine — bigger than the sky and deeper than the sea. He showed His love by sending His Son, Jesus. We didn't have to earn it; God loved us first, just because. And nothing can ever stop God from loving you.
moral.application: Whenever you feel sad, small, or unsure, remember the biggest truth of all: God loves you, He always has, and nothing will ever change that.

style: Flat-color children's cartoon storybook illustration, simple rounded shapes, soft warm colors, thick clean black outlines, bright and friendly, gentle lighting, 16:9 landscape composition, no text or words in the image, no letters.

beats.scene: A cheerful young child with short brown hair standing outside under a huge warm sky with a glowing sun, arms open, feeling loved, the whole world bright and welcoming.
text: God loves the whole big world —
and that means God loves YOU.

beats.scene: The same brown-haired child standing on a hill looking out at a vast sky and a deep blue ocean, amazed at how big it all is, warm glowing light.
text: God's love is bigger than the tallest sky.
It is deeper than the deepest sea.

beats.scene: A gentle warm nativity-style scene: a soft glowing star shining over a humble stable, representing God sending His Son Jesus, peaceful and tender.
text: God showed His great love in the best way of all.
He sent His own Son, Jesus, to us.

beats.scene: The brown-haired child being warmly hugged from behind by a loving parent figure, both smiling, cozy and safe, soft warm light.
text: We didn't have to earn God's love.
God loved us first — just because He wanted to.

beats.scene: The brown-haired child smiling joyfully with a big glowing heart of light all around them, feeling completely safe and loved, radiant and warm.
text: Nothing can ever stop God from loving you.
God made you, God knows you, and God loves you — forever.
